# [: Check file types and compare values. Returns a status of 0 if the condition evaluates to true, 1 if it evaluates to false. See also: `test`.
- Test if a given variable is equal to the specified string: [ "${{variable}}" = "{{string}}" ]
- Test if a given variable is not equal to the specified string: [ "${{variable}}" != "{{string}}" ]
- Test if a given variable is [eq]ual/[n]ot [e]qual/[g]reater [t]han/[l]ess [t]han/[g]reater than or [e]qual/[l]ess than or [e]qual to the specified number: [ "${{variable}}" -{{eq|ne|gt|lt|ge|le}} {{integer}} ]
- Test if the specified variable has a [n]on-empty value: [ -n "${{variable}}" ]
- Test if the specified variable has an empty value ([z]ero length): [ -z "${{variable}}" ]
- Test if the specified [f]ile exists: [ -f {{path/to/file}} ]

# unzip: Extract files/directories from Zip archives. See also: `zip`.

- List the contents of a specific archive without extracting them: unzip -l {{path/to/archive}}.zip
